note: PRC-12 smoke test. Builds two Pulse Turrets on anchor-01 at boot, then asserts the run is still alive and has not leaked by frame 1800 -- 30 seconds of game time at the default (slowest) speed, which anchor-01's own 20s prep lead-in means is still wave 1. This is the harness's own proof of life: build/select-equivalent actions execute, the frame counter advances, and an assertion at a late frame is evaluated and passes -- not a claim about anchor-01's balance.
